title: S. Korean Students Dream of Becoming Athletes
paragraphs: What do children in South Korea want to be when they grow up? According to a new report, many young students dream of becoming athletes.

The report was released in July by South Korea's Ministry of Education and the Korean Educational Development Institute. It looked at the career hopes of students at elementary, middle and high schools across the country.

For elementary school students, the most popular dream job was athlete. It was also the top choice in 2020. Doctor came second, and content creator came third. In 2015, the top dream job for elementary school students was teacher.
Some reports say that famous athletes, such as the soccer star Son Heung-min, may be one reason why many children want to play sports.

For students in middle school, the most popular dream job was teacher, followed by athlete and doctor. Teacher was also the top choice for high school students. In fact, teacher has been the number one dream job for middle and high school students for 12 years in a row. Among high school students, nurse came second, and scientists and researchers came third.
The report also found that fewer students have decided what they want to do in the future. In 2015, 91.3% of elementary school students had a dream job. In 2025, the number fell to 78.1%.

High school students' plans for the future are also changing. Fewer of them want to go to university. Meanwhile, the number who plan to get a job after high school rose from 7.0% in 2023 to 15.6% in 2025.
